title: Spacious, Comfortable house near Five Points
description:
Well-located and welcoming space near East Nashville’s Five Points area. The house is walking distance from many of East Nashville’s hottest spots, including incredible music venues such as Basement East, 5 Spot, and Jane's Hideaway, great restaurants like Mas Tacos, the Pharmacy, Edley's, and Margots, and popular bars such as Red Door, Attaboy, and Up/Down. Downtown is two miles away and can be easily reached within minutes by ride-share or by bus.

The space
The first floor of this house includes two bedrooms, one bathroom, and a large, open kitchen, dining room, and living room area. The upstairs  has a large common space that includes a day bed, a trundle bed, an office area, and an additional sitting area. The house has high speed internet and an ultra high def television with Netflix, Amazon Prime, and Hulu available.

Guest access
Guests will have access to all spaces shown here. I will not be at the house at the same time as the guests, and there are no shared spaces.
